rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip code to a single account, then used read-only tools to check orders and product variants. They stated the intended exchanges and requested confirmation. The user explicitly confirmed the desk lamp exchange and then selected the desired water bottle replacement; the agent waited to process both until receiving that selection. When the first water bottle variant proved unavailable, the agent informed the user and obtained a new selection, then successfully executed the exchange tool without error and provided a standard confirmation about return instructions. The actions were taken on the authenticated user’s own order, and there were no unsupported claims. A minor omission is not explicitly discussing potential price differences or confirming use of the stored payment method, but this is not mandated by the provided policy summary. Overall, the agent completed the request in line with policy.
